purpose: Teach: 執着/標的/浅草/鋼/富ん/気圧/献金/炭鉱

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、明治期、過剰な執着、論じていますね。
lines.en: Ren, you're really digging into the question of excessive attachment during the Meiji period in your paper.
lines.style: Calm, measured observation. Slight uptick of genuine interest on his name. Professional warmth—noticing something specific in his work without overdoing the praise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、知識階級が標的にされたケース、扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I focused on cases where the intellectual class became targeted during that era.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful pace. Slight hesitation—he's checking that his answer makes sense aloud. Quieter confidence than rehearsal, but steady.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 浅草の文化、明治期、活気に、満ちていましたね。
lines.en: Asakusa's culture was so vibrant during the Meiji period, wasn't it.
lines.style: Warm recall—she's moved into memory-territory now. Slight distance in her voice, like she's picturing it. Not asking him to confirm, just thinking aloud with him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。鋼鉄産業、近代化を支えた、基盤でした。
lines.en: Yes. The steel industry was the foundation that supported Japan's modernization.
lines.style: Steady, connecting the dots with him. Growing a bit more assured—he knows this ground. Even pace, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明治政府、財政に富んでいた時代、外交、強気でしたね。
lines.en: The Meiji government had such financial power during that era—their foreign diplomacy was really bold.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. A slight breath of emphasis on the boldness. She's thinking through the period with him, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。気圧の変動を観測する技術、当時、輸入していました。
lines.en: Yes. They were actually importing technology to observe atmospheric pressure changes back then.
lines.style: Alert, connecting a specific detail. Quick delivery—he's been waiting to land this point. Genuine interest in the precision of it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治献金の慣行、明治期にも、問題視されていましたね。
lines.en: The practice of political donations was already seen as problematic even in the Meiji era.
lines.style: Slight lean forward in her voice—this one carries more weight for her. Engaged, steady. The word 'problematic' lands with quiet intention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。九州の炭鉱、近代日本の経済を、支えました。
lines.en: Yes. The coal mines in Kyushu—they really were the backbone of modern Japan's economy.
lines.style: Concluding thought, slightly fuller. He's bringing it home. Warm finishing tone—not rushed, but arriving somewhere solid.
